summary: Missing drugs from the medical warehouse
body: Jared Consley: I am notifying the central warehouse that there have been disappearances of medical drugs and reagents from warehouse MW14. The largest loss was of pseudoephedrine, but recently methylamine has started disappearing, whole barrels at a time. Such disappearances have been occurring for several weeks now. We have not yet been able to find the cause of the disappearance of drugs from the warehouse, but we, together with the security service, plan to find out in the near future.
